name: caia-page-libraries
description: Not installed by anything. The three libraries CAIA's page loads from jsDelivr, at the versions pinned in next/src/caia/web/app.py (PAGE_LIBS), listed here so that Dependabot proposes an update when one of them gets a new version. A proposal fails next/tests until PAGE_LIBS has the same version and the new file's hash: docs/RUNBOOK.md, 'Bibliotek i sidan'.
